purpose: W10-B: add server-backed platform entitlements, post-registration organization lifecycle and marketplace moderation registries while reusing existing membership/security controls and never modifying registration or Role Eligibility.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Registration, membership creation/role assignment and Role Eligibility remain invariant. W10-B reads existing organization/member state but does not modify those authorities.
Current team UI is source evidence; role UX wiring is later and cannot drive lifecycle authority.
Provider registry/maturity remains independent. Moderation can reference provider/listing facts but cannot rewrite provider verification.
First governance authority can remain unmounted or use separately bounded wiring.

requiredInvariants: Platform entitlement is a separate access/commercial entitlement axis and never replaces membership role, job profile, organization capability, Role Eligibility or domain permission checks.

Entitlement definitions are versioned/effective-dated and may govern plan/module limits, feature availability or quotas only where domain policy explicitly declares an entitlement dependency. Missing entitlement fails closed for that feature but cannot revoke unrelated legal/role authority.

Post-registration organization lifecycle uses explicit states/transitions such as ACTIVE, RESTRICTED, SUSPENDED, CLOSING, ARCHIVED where policy permits. Registration-created identity facts are not edited to simulate lifecycle changes.

Suspension/restriction reasons, scope, effective time, evidence, actor and appeal/review references are immutable/versioned. Historical transactions remain readable/auditable under policy even when new actions are blocked.
Organization closure/archive cannot physically delete canonical Deals, documents, ledger, evidence or audit history and must obey retention/legal-hold rules.

Marketplace moderation applies to listings/offers/provider/service/public content as a separate moderation decision. Hidden/blocked content status is not proof the underlying commodity/provider/organization is illegal, fraudulent or unverified.
Moderation decisions are versioned, reason-coded, evidence-linked, appealable where policy allows and cannot silently rewrite listing/provider source facts.

Staff/control-plane moderation and organization restriction require explicit staff authority, recent MFA where high risk, exact scope and immutable audit/outbox receipt; ordinary organization users cannot self-grant staff entitlement.
Two-person approval may be required for platform-wide or irreversible high-risk governance actions according to a pinned policy; same user/membership cannot satisfy both approvals.
Current actor/member/org/staff authority is revalidated before mutation/replay; revoked authority cannot replay an old governance receipt as current authorization.
Tenant isolation applies to organization-private lifecycle/entitlement records; platform-wide staff views use a distinct control-plane authority, never a browser-selected tenant override.
No governance action creates external provider success, financial settlement, signature, KYC/AML verification or regulatory finality; it only gates platform behavior within its explicit policy scope.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, canonical domain records, external credentials and REG.RU topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove versioned entitlement assignment/effective evaluation without altering membership role/job profile/capability authority.
Organization lifecycle tests prove scoped restriction/suspension/archive, immutable history, action gating and continued historical read/audit retention.
Moderation tests prove listing/content/provider-reference decisions are reason/evidence/version bound and cannot mutate underlying source verification facts.
High-risk staff governance tests cover recent MFA, two-person distinct approver rules, stale/revoked staff authority and replay/conflict cases.
Cross-tenant organization access and browser-selected staff/tenant scope fail closed.
Audit/outbox/event failure rolls back governance mutation and no partial restriction/entitlement/moderation receipt remains.
Registration/Role Eligibility regression proves zero code/behavior change to those contours.
Exact-head CI/review plus REG.RU staff/organization lifecycle acceptance remain required before terminal governance credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Privacy/data-subject/processor governance from section 55 remains a separate W10-C slice.
Settings W8-C and role activation W8-A consume entitlements/lifecycle after both authorities are accepted.
Commercial plan/billing model must define entitlement products without turning entitlements into money ledger authority.
Real organization/staff human acceptance and legal retention review remain mandatory.
